benefits.text: Up to 5X rewards points for every dollar spent on eligible dining transactions
texts: Up to 5X rewards points for every dollar spent on eligible dining transactions
Up to 5X 1 Rewards Points
Get up to 5X rewards points for every S$1 spent on eligible dining transactions.
1X 1 Rewards Points
Get 1X 1 rewards points for every S$1 spent, on all other eligible transactions (insurance related spends included).

The new Card benefits will allow you to earn additional 4X Rewards Points per S$1 spent in local currency on Qualifying Dining Transactions, and additional 9X Rewards Points per S$1 spent in foreign currency on Qualifying Foreign Currency Transactions.
Such additional Rewards Points are subject to a cap of 20,000 Rewards Points per year.

This is in additional to the total rewards points earned for other qualifying spends which accords 1X rewards points for every S$1 (or its equivalent for spends that are not made in Singapore Dollars, where relevant) spent with the Prudential Platinum Card.
1.For all Qualifying Dining Transactions, you will earn additional 4X Reward Points for every S$1 spent in Singapore Dollars; and
2.For every Qualifying Foreign Currency, you will earn additional 9X Reward Points for every S$1 spent in foreign currency (spends that are not made in Singapore Dollars).
Can I earn more than 20,000 Rewards Points on my Prudential Platinum Credit Card?
The Rewards Cap of 20,000 Rewards Points only applies to the additional Rewards Points awarded on Qualifying Dining Transactions and Qualifying Foreign Currency transactions.

Once you reach the cap, you may continue to earn 1X Reward Point per S$1 (or its equivalent for spends that are not made in Singapore Dollars, where relevant) spent on the card on all eligible Prudential Card Transactions
